title: Washington landowner's dam repairs led to neighbour's pond filling with sediment; what the court said
summary_full: In a pivotal decision, a Washington state court upheld a significant $554,000 judgment against Robert Shawn Noecker due to extensive property damages linked to unauthorized construction on a malfunctioning dam. This mishap not only unleashed water and debris but was further exacerbated by drainage modifications that redirected water onto his land.
